scope: Explicitly configured complimentary testing access for canonical shared Fallsoft identities, including before ordinary first profile creation. Existing UUID grants preserved.
accepted_shape: Exact canonical fallsoft-vipi-production:user_* identities; never email, wildcard, raw legacy subject or client-supplied UUID.
checks: Normal first profile chooses its own username and receives Base/Bot review access only for configured stored identity
Ordinary and same-raw-ID legacy users retain normal 30-day cardless Base and no Bot entitlement
Query account-ID spoof cannot obtain another user grant
Missing, deleted and suspended accounts cannot use grants
No fabricated purchase records; provider consent, quota/spending and UUID grant behavior remain intact
initial_setup_issue: First run passed29 synchronous cases;15 async cases could not create their temporary directory because its parent did not yet exist. JUnit retained. Those15 rerun unchanged after directory availability and passed.
database: Isolated SQLite fixtures; no schema change or live provider call
remaining: Live authenticated entitlement readback after owner profile exists
